metadata.obs_schema: 21-dim one-hot: op[0:3] (SET=0, SWAP=1, ADD=2), reg_a[3:7], reg_b[7:11], immediate[11:21]
metadata.statistical_discipline: Five frozen E checkpoints are the independent units; F is a control. Raw-observation/history probes are analysis-only, fit on ordinary TRAIN ADD transitions, tuned on VAL, evaluated once on the untouched canonical TEST. Every predeclared history length and capacity is reported; no test-based selection. Exact Bayes collision statistics are computed independently of any probe.

primary_decision.rule_note: U-MIX first (E/F categories disagree or wrap/no-wrap spread >=0.15 at >=2 lengths); U-B if Bayes_target(full) < 0.99; U-D if Bayes_target(full) >=0.99 and best full-prefix probe held-out <=0.25 with gap >=0.30; U-A if Bayes_target(full) >=0.99 and best full-prefix probe >=0.50 with held-out >=0.30; U-C if Bayes_target(L=1) <=0.50 and the Bayes curve is non-decreasing and reaches >=0.99 at finite L*. Bars are declared conventions; continuous values reported.
